principle: Conversations produce decisions. Approved documents preserve decisions.

tracks.name: Initial Baseline
tracks.caption: Establish the project's approved design and implementation boundaries.

stages.receives: Open questions, observations and creative possibilities
stages.complete: The brief is approved for design work; the workspace remains open
stages.return: Any new mechanic, content, presentation thought, experiment or refinement

stages.complete: Game-level design is architecture-ready and approved
Current approved truth has an authoritative home

stages.receives: Approved Game Design Brief and relevant Bible context
stages.complete: Architecture review and creator approval pass
stages.return: Capabilities, ownership, authority, dependencies or major relationships change

stages.workspace: One persistent Work chat per module
stages.receives: Architecture, Module Map entry and relevant Bible truth
stages.produces: Approved Module Requirements, Slice Map and Slice specifications
stages.return: Requirements or slicing for that module change

stages.produces: Complete Slice Map and approved specifications
stages.complete: Every currently required Slice is approved
stages.return: Delivery boundaries or acceptance evidence change

stages.workspace: One persistent Codex chat per module
stages.receives: Repository reality, AGENTS.md, Architecture, Module Requirements and current Slice
stages.return: An approved Slice or implementation change affects the module

stages.produces: Pass, Pass With Deviations, Fail or Blocked
stages.return: Every meaningful Slice, Module, integration, prototype or milestone

tracks.name: Continuous Development
tracks.caption: Allow the game to evolve without bypassing ownership or losing current truth.

stages.complete: The creator chooses whether it should proceed
stages.return: Creativity can return here at any time
A later approved change affects the same truth

stages.agent: Architecture Agent when capability ownership is unclear
stages.complete: The highest affected ownership level is known

stages.receives: Revised approved specification and repository reality

stages.complete: The change is accepted or routed back
stages.return: After each meaningful approved implementation change
